name: 16-dependencies
title: Dependency claims
about: One package landed in the manifest, one did not.
patch:
diff --git a/package.json b/package.json
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
   "dependencies": {
+    "zod": "^4.1.0",
diff --git a/package-lock.json b/package-lock.json
--- a/package-lock.json
+++ b/package-lock.json
@@ -0,0 +1,1 @@
+    "node_modules/zod": {
